text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yamanin Zephyr and I are on our way home after a day out when…

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Do you like the rain, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I associate Yamanin Zephyr with the wind, so it's unusual to hear her mention the rain. I look up at the sky, and sure enough…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rainclouds. Right on cue, a drop hits my head, then another. It looks like it's about to pour…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I can't have her catching a cold. I hurry her into a nearby building to get us out of the rain. However…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: When I turn around, she's gone.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I look around to see that she's been distracted by a movie poster with sparrows, baby boars, and other forest animals on it.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Hello, Chubby Cheeks and Snorty-Snorts on the poster. I wonder whether I'll get to meet you all in person.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's for a 4D movie, the kind where wind blows, rain falls, and even the chairs shake.
choice_data_list: Do you want to see it?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: It's as if I've been touched by the dawn wind. An unfamiliar wind is blowing, right here…

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Though the wind and rain of the sky bring me comfort and still my heart, it appears this is not their true form.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: It would be nice to immerse myself in this unfamiliar wind.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I take that as a yes. As she heads off to the theater by herself, I stop her and suggest that I come along.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Oh, thank you. What a gentle breeze you are—attentive to every wind in the sky.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Hehe. My heart dances, as if bathing in the efflorescent breeze.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I feel pressure building deep within, like the encroaching twilight. But for now, it is no different from a mellow breeze. Right, let's go.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yamanin Zephyr and I head into the theater. She seems unusually antsy.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Fah la laaa! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The movie is a heartwarming children's story about a little girl who gets lost in the forest and befriends the animals she encounters.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Come wind or storm, the girl and her forest friends work together to overcome hardship and, at the end, all sing a song together.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Yes, I did. The Chubby Cheeks sang a wonderfully breezy little song, and the Snorty-Snorts danced like lively winds. I thought it was very charming.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Even the girl's melody was akin to a radiant breeze. Oooh, la la laaa. ♪
choice_data_list: Did you feel the wind and rain?
The seats really shook a lot.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: No. The welkin wind cannot blow inside a closed-off space like that.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: When you hide the heavens, you wall yourself off from its blessings.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: As such, however free of chatter and noise the enclosure may be, it matters not in the end. Let's return to the outdoors.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: The singing, the dancing, and the melodies were very charming, but I prefer the real thing.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Do you like the rain, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After asking me the same question she did earlier, Yamanin Zephyr steps outside.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I do. I can lose myself in the pitter-patter of a light drizzle and the low roar of a downpour.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeing her standing there, getting soaked in the rain as if it's the most natural thing in the world, I find myself utterly unable to argue.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Perhaps this wind will bring cold, but in this moment, it feels so refreshing. Let us walk in harmony with it.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: See? It feels wonderful. Now, take a deep breath and stretch out your arms.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Let the cleansing rain and benison breeze envelop you.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Yes, they rumbled and jolted. The sensation was entirely different from being buffeted by a windstorm… It was almost a little painful.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: No, but I think I've experienced enough "4D" for now. Besides, the Chubby Cheeks never landed on my shoulders, nor did the Snorty-Snorts sit on my lap.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I find myself wanting to go and see them.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: The rain has stopped, hasn't it? Let's go sing and dance together. We'll assume the girl's role and lend the wind our own melody.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: It won't matter if the rain starts again, because it will stop again in time. And rain is a blessing from the heavens, after all.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: La la laaa. ♪ Fah la laaa. ♪ Chubby Cheeks, Snorty-Snorts—I'll be with you soon!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yamanin Zephyr skips off into the rain, and I chase after her.
